name: bench-rouge
title: Rouge's visual samples and demos, two per lexer, without names
labels: Rouge's maintainers (the file is named after its lexer's tag), crosswalked to Linguist's names
sampling: curated (every visual sample and distinct demo of a language)
strengths: content only: no file name, so every identifier is tested on the bytes
two sizes per language: a long visual sample and a short demo
independent of Linguist: one file is a Linguist sample
weaknesses: Rouge's home turf: its lexers are tested on these very files, and its taxonomy is the label set
samples written to exercise a lexer (many are lists of edge cases); demos are a few lines
two files per language at most
